## Change

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Link the relevant PRD, ADR, design, or plan when it helps the review.

## Validation

State what was checked and the result. For documentation-only changes, note the link and consistency checks. Do not list commands that were not run.

## Deployment

If this change needs a release or a `haynes-ops` update, link it and state the verification result. Otherwise write “Not applicable.”
